description: THE OUT-OF-RANGE SUBSCRIPT THAT IS INSIDE THE TABLE BUT PAST THE COUNT - the middle of the three subscript-boundary cases this directory carries for gate G33: case06 drives a subscript below the OCCURS range, this case one inside it but unvalued, and case09 one far beyond it. Option 11 reaches the three-term guard at app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:127-129 and the terms are evaluated in source order, which is gate G30: '11' IS numeric so term one is false; term two, WS-OPTION > CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT, is TRUE because the count is the 10 that app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:21 declares as PIC 9(02) VALUE 10; term three is never reached. Line 130 moves 'Y' into WS-ERR-FLG - the 88 ERR-FLG-ON condition at :41 - lines 131-132 move the thirty-seven-character invalid-option literal into WS-MESSAGE PIC X(80) at :38, and line 133 performs SEND-MENU-SCREEN. The normalisation above it is a deliberate contrast with case06: the descending test-before scan at :117-121 finds OPTIONI(2:1) already non-blank and exits at once with WS-IDX = 2, so the two-byte move at :122 into the PIC X(02) JUST RIGHT receiver at :45 needs no right-justification and the INSPECT REPLACING ALL ' ' BY '0' at :123 is a no-op - where case06's blank field is precisely what that INSPECT turns into '00'. Line 125 echoes the rejected value unchanged, so OPTIONO is '11', neither spaces nor '00'. Then the point of the case: PERFORM returns, so control falls through to the filter at :136-137, which is NOT guarded by IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON and so evaluates CDEMO-MENU-OPT-USRTYPE(11) with the error flag already set. The commarea supplies CDEMO-USER-TYPE 'U', which makes the first conjunct CDEMO-USRTYP-USER true and forces the second to actually be read - with 'A' the conjunction would short-circuit and the subscript would never be touched. CDEMO-MENU-OPT OCCURS 12 TIMES at app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:88 and COBOL subscripts are 1-based, so 11 is inside the declared range; but CDEMO-MENU-OPTIONS REDEFINES CDEMO-MENU-OPTIONS-DATA at :87 is larger than the item it redefines. Each entry is 2 + 35 + 8 + 1 = 46 bytes; the data division gives VALUE clauses to ten entries, 10 x 46 = 460 bytes, while the redefinition spans twelve, 12 x 46 = 552 bytes - so 92 bytes, exactly slots 11 and 12, have no backing data whatsoever. That oversized REDEFINES is a legacy defect and it is preserved rather than repaired: the filter stays ungated, its subscript stays able to leave the valued span, and the unreachable 'A' arm stays unreachable. The read is bounded to 1..12 and yields nothing, so :137 is false, no second screen is painted, and the No access text never appears. Line 145's IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON is then false, so the whole navigation block at :146-164 is skipped: no XCTL, so no successor is named and the termination is the EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID of :107-110; CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT stays 1 because :151 never runs; CDEMO-FROM-TRANID and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM keep their inbound values because :147-148 never run; and ERRMSGC is never overridden because the MOVE DFHGREEN of :158 is inside that block. What the case asserts most sharply is the pair expectedReturnCode 0 and exactly one entry in expectedMessages, and both are load-bearing. COMEN01C contains no RETURN-CODE, no CALL 'CEE3ABD' and no ABEND anywhere in its 282 lines, so a faithful run completes normally even though the filter read a slot with no data; an implementation that let an IndexOutOfBoundsException escape - a bare get(option - 1), or an array trimmed to the active count of ten - cannot produce return code 0, and one that read the unvalued bytes as 'A' would emit a second image carrying the No access text instead. The count of one is meaningful rather than incidental, because :127-134, :136-143 and :157-164 are three sequential IF statements rather than exclusive branches, so two images really are structurally possible here, as case10 demonstrates. In honesty about what this case does not prove: an implementation that wrongly gated the filter on the error flag would also pass it, because the shipped table's ten CDEMO-MENU-OPT-USRTYPE columns are all 'U' (:29, :35, :41, :47, :53, :59, :65, :72, :78, :84) and the filter's true arm is unreachable from real data - so what is decisively proved here is boundedness at a subscript past the valued span, not ungatedness, which case10 owns. The ten forty-character option lines are still built, because SEND-MENU-SCREEN at :182 performs BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS at :185 before the SEND, and that loop at :238-239 runs only while WS-IDX is not greater than the count of ten - so OPTN011O and OPTN012O, whose EVALUATE arms exist at :269-272, are never written and stay as the MOVE LOW-VALUES of :89 left them, forty X'00' characters each rather than spaces. No highlight is expected and none may be: COMEN01C does not copy CSSETATY - its COPY list at :50-61 is COCOM01Y, COMEN02Y, COMEN01, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CSUSR01Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA - and the DFHRED-plus-asterisk error highlight that copybook applies belongs to COACTUPC, its only consumer. DFHRED appears nowhere in this program's source; the DFHRED recorded against ERRMSGC here is the mnemonic of the COLOR=RED the map itself declares at app/bms/COMEN01.bms:154-157, reported unchanged precisely because the program never touched the attribute - which is why the error is signalled by the message text and the error flag alone. Gate G38's pair is therefore honoured through the ENTER and REENTER split rather than through any colour: this is a REENTER-side case, arriving with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT 1 so that :87 sends it down the RECEIVE-and-validate path, and the message and the flag become non-default only there. No thank-you line is expected either; COTTL01Y's CCDA-THANK-YOU and CSMSG01Y's CCDA-MSG-THANK-YOU are both copied in and neither is ever referenced. inputs, expectedWrites and expectedFinalState are all empty, and that is a positive assertion rather than an omission: COMEN01C performs no dataset access at all - it declares WS-USRSEC-FILE at :39 and copies CSUSR01Y at :58, but there is no SELECT, no FD and no file operand among its five EXEC CICS commands - and case18 pins that absence for the whole directory. User type is inbound only and is never re-verified, because :150's MOVE SEC-USR-TYPE TO CDEMO-USER-TYPE is commented out, so this single PIC X(01) comparison is the entire authorisation mechanism, exactly as the legacy program leaves it. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:33, the instant COMEN01C's own version footer at :281 carries, and US-ASCII is named explicitly rather than left to a platform default; POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :212-231 does run on this path, so CURDATE and CURTIME are genuinely produced in the MM/DD/YY and HH:MM:SS shapes of app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy, and all twenty cases in this directory pin that same instant so no two can differ by their clock. Every expected value here is statically derived - read out of the COBOL paragraph that produces it and cross-checked against the option table and 46-byte entry layout of app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy, the sixteen-field 160-byte commarea of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY, the DFHMDF definitions of app/bms/COMEN01.bms and the CM00-to-COMEN01C binding of app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD - and none of it was captured from an execution of the legacy program, which is empirically impossible here: no z/OS or CICS runtime, an indexed file handler the available compiler reports as disabled, no Language Environment CEE services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository altogether. That substitution of provenance is escalated rather than absorbed (risk R-A).
